author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the LG monitor situation where a set of products on the market have come preinstalled with software that takes screenshots for "analysis", we're facing software being pushed to us that we don't want and it's time we stop it and keep ourselves safe. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Your Computer Monitor Is Spying On You...
